name: Democratic Party
description: Follow Democratic Party, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Thanedar becomes latest incumbent to fall to a progressive challenger
changes.summary: Michigan Rep. Shri Thanedar lost his primary to democratic socialist Donavan McKinney on Wednesday — the latest victory for progressives who’ve been on a hot streak of ousting incumbents in safe-blue districts. Thanedar’s 13th District was a top priority for groups like Justice Democrats that are committed to primaryin.

changes.title: Progressives see biggest win yet in Michigan, while Trump flexes power over GOP
changes.summary: Progressives notched major wins in Michigan, while voters in Missouri and Washington rejected insurgent Democrats. Meanwhile, Trump continued to flex his influence over the Republican Party. (Image credit: Bill Pugliano).

changes.title: House Democrats just added 12 'safe' Trump districts to their midterm election target list
changes.summary: The move brings the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee's list of targets to 58, an ambitious list that reflects President Donald Trump's diminished standing with the electorate and Democrats' belief that they can capitalize on voters' frustrations.

changes.title: Virginia Democrats pick establishment nominees for 2 House seats they hope to flip
changes.summary: In Virginia, Democratic primary voters have a history of rewarding moderate candidates, a trend that continued on Tuesday.

changes.title: Takeaways from Tuesday's elections in Michigan and more
changes.summary: Democrats need to rack up as many wins as possible to take back the U.S. Senate, so the party has little room for error.

changes.title: Progressives didn’t get the big election night they wanted
changes.summary: Progressives didn’t get the earthquake they expected. Moderates are relishing in their stronger than expected showing. changes.title: Pastor Adam Hamilton Wins Kansas Democratic Senate Primary
changes.summary: The Rev. Adam Hamilton will be a serious underdog against Roger Marshall, a Republican, but Democrats think the state could be competitive if the November environment is favorable enough to them.

changes.title: Progressives and moderate Democrats both see wins in primary races while Trump flexes power over GOP
changes.summary: Everyone got a little bit of what they wanted in Tuesday's primary elections. It was a good night for the Democratic establishment, the progressives and Republican candidates endorsed by President Trump. (Image credit: Bill Pugliano).

changes.title: Senate Democrats say banks turned blind eye to suspicious moves by Jeffrey Epstein
changes.summary: A report from Senate Democrats accuses big banks of failing to report suspicious money transfers made by Jeffrey Epstein until after his arrest in 2019. (Image credit: Martin Bureau).

changes.title: Trump takes trip to West Coast to tout the economy, something polls show he's weak on
changes.summary: President Donald Trump is making a rare visit to California and Nevada to try to draw contrasts with Democrats on the economy and other issues.
